value.syntax: # [doc = " An unchecked act candidate; downstream operations require `ValidatedRecords`."] # [doc = " (´def:acts:carrier´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct CandidateAct { # [doc = " Retained public commitment residues, absent only for uncommitted internal inputs."] pub commitments : Option < commitments :: ActCommitments > , # [doc = " Authored structural identity."] pub id : ActId , # [doc = " Unchanged structural body with units and vintages."] pub body : StructuralBody , # [doc = " Immutable structural legs, always owned together by this candidate."] pub legs : Vec < CandidateLeg > , # [doc = " One-way removal facts for the act, never for an individual co-leg."] pub projections : RemovableProjections , # [doc = " Immutable protocol references, independently required even after removal."] pub protocol_references : Vec < PublicReference > , # [doc = " Public authentication evidence; retained, not cryptographically certified."] pub authentication_evidence : authentication :: AuthenticationFields , # [doc = " Accepted finalization epoch, not identity or a quantity's vintage."] pub finalization_epoch : u64 , # [doc = " Host-authoritative order; never used for identity equality."] pub authoritative_position : u64 , # [doc = " Host-attached logical time, retained unchanged and never authored identity."] pub logical_time : u64 , }
